definitions.full: H2356. chor III. חוֺר חֹר, noun [masculine] hole ; — absolute חֹר 2Kin 12:10 ; Ezek 8:7 (strike out Co B etc.), חוֺר Song 5:4 , חֹרִים 1Sam 14:11 ; construct חֹרֵי Job 30:6 ; suffix חֹרָיו Nahum 2:13 , חֹרֵיהֶן Zech 14:12 ; — hole in lid of chest 2Kin 12:10 (made by boring, נקב ), in door Song 5:4 ; in wall Ezek 8:7 (see above); = eye-socket בְּח תִּמַּקְנָה ׳עיניו Zech 14:12 (plague of enemies of Jerusalem); holes as hiding-places for men 1Sam 14:11 , so also 13:6 Ew We Dr (for חוחים ᵑ0 ), dwelling of outcast people עָפָר חרי Job 30:6 ; of dens of lions Nahum 2:13 . — I. חֹר , see II. חור .
